content.summary: Implemented WI-01 timeout path baseline tests

acceptance_criteria_status.criterion: No timeout configured path has no AbortSignal.timeout and keeps timeout: false
Numeric timeout path adds AbortSignal.timeout and combines with existing signal
timeout=false path skips AbortSignal.timeout and preserves existing signals
All three tests pass with bun test test/provider/timeout-paths.test.ts

data.notes: Implemented a local file:// provider harness that captures the wrapped fetch from provider.ts and validates runtime signal behavior for each timeout config path without refactoring production code.
